Keele's expository redemptive-historical preaching is well regarded. Green.

score_notes.cultural: OPC tradition conservative on social issues — green.

escondido-urc-ca.assessment: Escondido URC is a flagship URCNA congregation in North San Diego County, pastored by Rev. Chris Gordon (host of Abounding Grace Radio and a widely recognized voice in confessional Reformed circles). The church holds strictly to the Three Forms of Unity (Belgic Confession, Heidelberg Catechism, Canons of Dort), preaches the Heidelberg Catechism in a second service, and maintains male-only officers. This is textbook confessional Continental Reformed practice — no women in office, no cultural drift, serious catechetical formation for children and adults.

score_notes.christology: Affirms Nicene orthodoxy via Belgic Confession.
score_notes.scripture: Reformed doctrine of Scripture — inerrant, sufficient, final authority.
score_notes.gender: Male-only officers (pastors, elders, deacons) per URCNA standard.
score_notes.leadership: Plurality of male elders; Church Order of Dordt.
score_notes.soteriology: Monergistic — Canons of Dort, salvation by grace alone.
score_notes.cultural: Strongly anti-progressive; historically rooted Reformed worship.
score_notes.mission: Evangelism and discipleship through Word and Sacrament: 'build each-other up, give a cup of water in Christ's name, and spread the gospel.'
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Active men's studies; Abounding Grace Radio (Rev. Gordon).
score_notes.denominational: URCNA re-confirmed on homepage. Two services (9:30am / 5:00pm) and Sunday School — classic URCNA pattern.
